title: When the Veil Sings
author: Paloma Blackwood
blurb: Vesper Halloran, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
